pretreatments.description: Substrates were anaerobically aged for 5 days in N2-saturated vessels at 35 ± 1 °C to adjust the chemical composition before co-digestion.
Substrates were co-digested in airtight glass reactors with NaOH and/or H2O2 added to adjust alkalinity, pH, and organic loading.

Substrates were mixed in two different mechanical configurations: a mechanical mixer (MM) and a pneu-mechanical mixer (PMM) within a semi-industrial biogas plant to test mixing effects on gas production and microbial communities.
Substrates were co-digested in a laboratory setting using a combined D-optimal experimental design with different ratios of cow manure, municipal waste, and kitchen waste.
